D000236.s: A benign epithelial tumor with a glandular organization.

D000368.s: A person 65 years of age or older. For a person older than 79 years, AGED, 80 and over is available.

D000382.s: Diseases in persons engaged in cultivating and tilling soil, growing plants, harvesting crops, raising livestock, or otherwise engaged in husbandry and farming.

D000405.s: A syndrome characterized by a silent and inert state without voluntary motor activity despite preserved sensorimotor pathways and vigilance. Bilateral frontal lobe dysfunction involving the anterior cingulate gyrus and related brain injuries are associated with this condition.

D001459.s: A country in Southern Asia, bordering the Bay of Bengal, between Burma and India. The capital is Dhaka.

D001723.s: The number of births in a given population per year or other unit of time.

D002054.s: A group of painful oral symptoms associated with a burning or similar sensation. There is usually a significant organic component with a degree of functional overlay; it is not limited to the psychophysiologic group of disorders.

D004647.s: Regulations or conditions imposed on employees by management in order to correct or prevent behaviors which are counterproductive to the organization.

D005002.s: An independent state in eastern Africa. Ethiopia is located in the Horn of Africa and is bordered on the north and northeast by Eritrea, on the east by Djibouti and Somalia, on the south by Kenya, and on the west and southwest by Sudan. Its capital is Addis Ababa.

D006410.s: The development and formation of various types of blood cells. Hematopoiesis can take place in the bone marrow (medullary) or outside the bone marrow (hematopoiesis, extramedullary).

D006942.s: An excess of gamma-globulins in the serum due to chronic infections or paraproteinemias.

D007079.s: Inflammation of any segment of the ileum and the ileocecal valve.

D007112.s: Resistance to a disease-causing agent induced by the introduction of maternal immunity into the fetus by transplacental transfer or into the neonate through colostrum and milk.

D008023.s: Fibrous cords of connective tissue that attach bones to each other and hold together the many types of joints in the body. Articular ligaments are strong, elastic, and allow movement in only specific directions, depending on the individual joint.

D009107.s: An acute infectious disease caused by rubulavirus, spread by direct contact, airborne droplet nuclei, fomites contaminated by infectious saliva, and perhaps urine, and usually seen in children under the age of 15, although adults may also be affected. (From Dorland, 28th ed)

D011252.s: The co-occurrence of pregnancy and neoplasms. The neoplastic disease may precede or follow fertilization.

D011469.s: Pathological processes involving the prostate or its component tissues.

D011836.s: The ability of some cells or tissues to survive lethal doses of ionizing radiation. Tolerance depends on the species, cell type, and physical and chemical variables, including radiation-protective agents and radiation-sensitizing agents.

D013337.s: Individuals enrolled in a school of medicine or a formal educational program in medicine.

D014624.s: An abnormal anatomical passage that connects the vagina to other organs, such as the bladder (vesicovaginal fistula) or the rectum (rectovaginal fistula).

D014848.s: Inflammation of the vulva and the vagina, characterized by discharge, burning, and pruritus.

D014941.s: The construction or arrangement of a task so that it may be done with the greatest possible efficiency.

D015335.s: A group of atoms or molecules attached to other molecules or cellular structures and used in studying the properties of these molecules and structures. D015340.s: The form and structure of analytic studies in epidemiologic research.

D017391.s: A procedure that modifies refractive errors by the transplantation of a donor cornea to the anterior surface of the patient's cornea.

D017445.s: Skin diseases affecting or involving the cutaneous blood vessels and generally manifested as inflammation, swelling, erythema, or necrosis in the affected area.

D018714.s: Radiotherapy given to augment some other form of treatment such as surgery or chemotherapy. Adjuvant radiotherapy is commonly used in the therapy of cancer and can be administered before or after the primary treatment.

D033061.s: Services provided by an individual ethicist (ethicists) or an ethics team or committee (ethics committees, clinical) to address the ethical issues involved in a specific clinical case.

D035881.s: Payment, or other means of making amends, for a wrong or injury.

D047549.s: Coronary artery bypass surgery on a beating heart without a cardiopulmonary bypass (diverting the flow of blood from the heart and lungs through an oxygenator).

D052756.s: The study of nutrition processes as well as the components of food, their actions, interaction, and balance in relation to health and disease.

e: National Institute on Alcohol Abuse and Alcoholism
de: National Institute on Alcohol Abuse and Alcoholism

D061286.s: Measurement of the osmolarity of solutions or body fluids.

D061848.s: The use of light interaction (scattering, absorption, and fluorescence) with biological tissue to obtain morphologically based information.

D062306.s: The area of medicine concerned with the effects on health and disease due to geographic factors such as climate, environmental conditions, and geographic location.

D065831.s: Members of a religious community of women typically living under vows of poverty, chastity, and obedience.

D000080308.s: An index of arterial stiffness obtained from pulse wave velocity measurements between the heart and the ankle.

D000088102.s: An eating disorder that is characterized by the pathological obsession with healthy eating.

D000093744.s: Compounds that reduce the non-enzymatic glycation of proteins, lipids, and nucleic acids AND thus reducing the formation of advanced glycation end-products.

D000094626.s: An abnormal balloon- or sac-like dilatation in the wall of the aortic arch.

D000096246.s: Operators of industrial equipment to generate electrical power.

D000097803.s: A transitory embryonic structure that appears during the 5th week post-fertilization.
